run_slurm_training: run distributed model training on a SLURM cluster using torchrun and a LazyConfig python config file
run_evaluation_only: run evaluation only on a trained detection model by passing --eval-only with a config file and checkpoint path
resume_training: resume interrupted training from the last checkpoint in the output directory using the --resume flag
run_do_test: run inference on a test dataset using the model and dataloader defined in the LazyConfig and print results in CSV format
run_do_train: run the full training loop with DDP model wrapping, optimizer, LR scheduler, periodic checkpointing, and evaluation hooks
